title: Elf-san wa Yaserarenai. Specials
justification: AniList 179126 (ONA, 2 episode(s) from 2024-10-06) is AniDB 18412's special(s) S1-S2, aired 2024-10-06 to 2024-10-20. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 173388, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 18412, and the special's title matches an AniList title. On TMDB 243743 the parent's node places the special(s) where TMDB's dates disagree (AniDB S1 aired 2024-10-06, TMDB 243743 S0E1 2024-07-07; AniDB S2 aired 2024-10-20, TMDB 243743 S0E2 2024-07-14), so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
